races.paceDynamic: King Of Speed and Miss Chester will likely dispute the early lead, with Daddy Chill also positioned prominently in this small field. The pace should be sustainable rather than frantic, as King Of Speed has shown he can lead without being pressured and Miss Chester tends to fade late. With the majority of the field comprising hold-up horses (Port Noir, Aim For The Bull, Berning Hot, Sceptic, Marchetti, Dinah Myte), they'll be looking to pounce in the final two furlongs. This race shape clearly favours the prominent racers and early pace-setters, as they can control the tempo without pressure and kick clear before the hold-up brigade can mount their challenge.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If King Of Speed and Miss Chester can establish an uncontested lead without racing too keenly early
scenarios.body: The pace will be controlled enough for them to have plenty left for the finish, making it difficult for the hold-up horses to close the gap. King Of Speed's recent form edge gives him the advantage over Miss Chester who has been struggling in handicaps.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Success
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely slow and the leaders come back to the field
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses will get their ideal scenario with plenty of room to manoeuvre and strong finishing kicks. Port Noir's course form and Sceptic's recent revival make them the most dangerous late threats.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle Unfolds
scenarios.trigger: If King Of Speed and Miss Chester go too fast early while trying to shake off each other
scenarios.body: They'll set it up perfectly for a mid-division runner to come through late when the leaders tire. Aim For The Bull's recent course win puts him in the ideal position to capitalize on such a scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If the form horses fail to fire and the pace becomes messy with no clear leader
scenarios.body: The race will fall apart tactically, allowing a horse with something to prove to sneak through. Marchetti's course experience or Dinah Myte's class could see one of them capitalize on the chaos.

watchPoints.text: King Of Speed could get an uncontested lead with Hope Regan's 7lb claim, making him very hard to peg back
Miss Chester's tendency to fade badly in the final furlong could see her collapse dramatically if she leads too long
Port Noir has won twice over course and distance this year, her hold-up style is perfectly suited if the pace is strong
Sceptic showed renewed vigour on turf last time at Nottingham, suggesting his AW struggles might be behind him
Several horses returning from lengthy breaks including Marchetti (65 days) and Daddy Chill (42 days) who may need the run

races.paceDynamic: Trio is the only confirmed front-runner in this field of nine, meaning he can dictate terms without early pressure and set a sustainable tempo. With eight hold-up horses behind him, the pace will be genuine but not frantic, allowing Trio to build a tactical advantage while the field bunches up in behind. The lack of pace pressure means horses with tactical speed who can position prominently will have a significant edge over those needing to come from the back. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and those with enough pace to track the leader, rather than pure hold-up horses who will face a wall of traffic in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Trio Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Trio gets an uncontested lead and maintains his rhythm
scenarios.body: The lone leader can dictate fractions and kick clear when the held-up horses are still organising behind him. Horses like Blues And Royals who can track close enough to strike benefit most from this tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Trio goes too slow early allowing the field to close up
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish with all nine horses in contention turning for home. Those with the best finishing kick from this bunched scenario will prevail over pure front-runners.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Trio Weakens Late
scenarios.trigger: If the leader's 19-day break tells in the final furlong
scenarios.body: After controlling the race, Trio's fitness gives way allowing the strongest finishers to sweep past in the final 100 yards. Recent winners with race fitness will have the edge.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Pace Challenge
scenarios.trigger: If one of the hold-up horses makes an early move to pressure Trio
scenarios.body: An unexpected early challenge creates genuine pace and sets up a true-run race favouring the strongest stayers. The tactical battle benefits horses who can adapt their usual running style.

watchPoints.text: Trio breaking slowly would completely change the pace dynamic as no other horse wants to make the running

runners_data.name: Cixi
runners_data.note: Only confirmed front runner can dictate pace without early pressure from this draw

races.paceDynamic: Cixi emerges as the sole confirmed front runner in this maiden field, with prominent racers Elshie, Lady Of Chivalry, Komodo Rose, and Perdy In Paris likely settling just behind her early. With only one horse wanting the lead, Cixi can dictate a comfortable tempo without early pressure, allowing her to control the race through steady fractions. The lack of pace pressure means hold-up horses like Snow Day, Venetian Gold, Katie's Song, and Sierra Sue will face a tactical disadvantage as they'll need the race to develop into a sprint finish. This race shape clearly favours prominent racers and the lone leader, as they can position close to a sustainable pace without having to overcome a strong finishing kick.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Cixi Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Cixi gets an easy lead and maintains her position turning for home.
scenarios.body: She can use her proven stamina to hold off late challenges, with the prominent racers best placed to capitalize if she falters. The controlled tempo plays directly into the hands of horses positioned within striking distance early.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Takeover
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent racers moves up to challenge Cixi approaching the turn.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a genuine test between those who positioned themselves handily, with Elshie and Perdy In Paris having the most recent form to suggest they can sustain a challenge. Hold-up horses struggle to make up the ground from too far back.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Newcomer Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If one of the unexposed three-year-olds shows significant improvement from debut running.
scenarios.body: The race develops as expected tactically, but a lightly-raced filly like Venetian Gold or one of the newcomers produces a performance well above their debut effort. The pace scenario remains the same but class levels prove different than expected.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Cixi fades dramatically and the prominent racers also fail to sustain their efforts.
scenarios.body: The moderate early pace suddenly becomes pedestrian, allowing the hold-up horses to close strongly in the final two furlongs. This requires multiple horses ahead to underperform significantly for the closers to get involved.

watchPoints.text: Cixi must be monitored for early pace judgement as sole leader facing no pressure could go too slow or too fast
Watch Venetian Gold for significant improvement second time out with Roger Varian's string in better form
Market support for any of the three newcomers will indicate stable confidence worth noting

Elshie's positioning from stall 1 could see her squeezed out if pace develops on outside

races.paceDynamic: Receipt and Iconic Times will contest the early lead, with Kit Gabriel and Arctician likely pressing from prominent positions. The pace should be genuine but not frantic given the moderate early speed, creating an honest gallop that will test stamina reserves in the final furlong. The large field of hold-up horses including Farasi Lane, Mr Baloo, and Notimeforchitchat will be bunched together turning for home. This race shape favors prominent runners who can avoid traffic problems and hold-up horses with proven finishing kicks at this venue.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Traffic-free late charge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is steady and the field spreads out in the straight
scenarios.body: Hold-up horses get clear runs and the early leaders tire, allowing closers to pick them off in the final 100 yards. Course specialists with proven finishing speed capitalize on their superior turn of foot.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent tactics prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is strong enough to compromise pure front-runners
scenarios.body: Those sitting just behind the leaders avoid the worst of the pace battle while staying out of trouble. They can strike approaching the final furlong when Receipt and Iconic Times begin to weaken.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-runner dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Receipt kicks clear turning for home and the field struggles to close
scenarios.body: The handicap debutant's class advantage shows as he builds an unassailable lead. Iconic Times and others cannot sustain their early positions, leaving the winner clear.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy scramble finish
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses and becomes stop-start through the middle sections
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical affair with no clear advantage to any running style. The winner emerges from a blanket finish where track position proves decisive over pure ability.

watchPoints.text: Receipt may hang right under pressure as he did when winning last time, potentially interfering with runners on his outside
Arctician drawn in stall 14 could struggle to get his preferred prominent position from the wide berth
Iconic Times and Kit Gabriel both need to prove their effectiveness over this seven-furlong trip having shown best form over shorter
Mr Baloo and Silca Bay wear cheekpieces for the first time and second time respectively, suggesting connections expect improvement
Tea Sea and Notimeforchitchat both return from lengthy breaks and may need the run despite their course credentials

races.paceDynamic: Bonnita is the only confirmed front-runner in this 12-runner handicap, with Yehudi the sole prominent runner, meaning a sustainable early pace without pressure. The majority of the field consists of hold-up horses who will need to be delivered late, creating a large pack settling behind the leaders. This race shape strongly favours front-running and prominent horses who can dictate terms, as the lack of early pace pressure will allow them to control the race and kick for home when it suits. Hold-up horses face the challenge of a potentially strung-out finish with limited pace to aim at.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Bonnita and Yehudi get an easy lead without early pressure.
scenarios.body: They can control the tempo completely and have too much left in the tank when the field tries to close late. The hold-up horses will struggle to make up ground on leaders who haven't been asked serious questions early.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely slow and one hold-up horse gets the perfect run.
scenarios.body: A horse with tactical speed can time their challenge to perfection in a sprint finish. The lack of early gallop sets up ideal conditions for a big finishing kick.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Acceleration
scenarios.trigger: If Yehudi decides to inject pace from halfway to put pressure on Bonnita.
scenarios.body: This creates a more even test where horses with some tactical speed can bridge the gap. The increased gallop stretches the field and favours those who can quicken off a strong pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses try to go forward early causing interference or a false pace.
scenarios.body: The race becomes tactical with stop-start fractions that don't suit anyone's natural running style. Chaos favours the most adaptable horses rather than those relying on specific race conditions.

watchPoints.text: Bonnita may not handle the AW surface after showing preference for soft/heavy turf conditions
Future Cutlet has drawn the widest stall which compounds his hold-up style in a pace-lacking race
Yehudi with Jack Mitchell could inject more pace than expected if they decide to press Bonnita early
Multiple first-time headgear changes on struggling horses could cause early interference
Taskheer with Hollie Doyle and first-time cheekpieces represents the strongest hold-up threat if pace materializes

races.paceDynamic: Due Date and Lethal Blast are confirmed front runners who will contest the early lead in this 6f handicap, with Due Date having recent form advantage over the long-absent Lethal Blast. Hint Of The Jungle and Fletcher's Flight will press from prominent positions, creating an honest gallop that should stretch the field. The strong early pace will set up the race for horses with tactical speed who can position themselves handy, as the held-up brigade including Rye, Elvetham and Big Bard may find themselves with too much ground to make up in a truly-run 6f contest. This race shape clearly favours prominent racers and those with tactical speed over pure hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tactical Speed
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is strong but sustainable between Due Date and Lethal Blast
scenarios.body: Hint Of The Jungle and Man On A Mission can position perfectly to strike, with the former's recent C&D form giving him the edge. The sustained gallop will find out the pure hold-up horses while suiting those racing within striking distance.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Due Date and Lethal Blast go too fast early and tie up
scenarios.body: The pace will collapse dramatically, allowing the best of the hold-up brigade to sweep through late. Rye and Big Bard have the class and finishing kick to capitalise when the leaders weaken badly in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Due Date finds his 2025 form and gets an easy lead
scenarios.body: The front runner will dictate terms and prove hard to peg back, with Lethal Blast's fitness concerns becoming apparent. Due Date's purple patch form gives him the engine to sustain his effort while others struggle to reel him in.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Lethal Blast Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Lethal Blast's 4-year absence proves irrelevant and she shows old speed
scenarios.body: The 9-year-old will shock the field with retained ability, benefiting from the light weight and front-running style. Her 2021 speed over 5f translates perfectly to leading this 6f contest, with the extended break potentially freshening her up.

watchPoints.text: Lethal Blast's fitness after 1443 days off - if she shows early speed the pace could be unsustainable
Due Date's early position - if he gets an easy lead he could prove hard to peg back
Hint Of The Jungle's early positioning with Fletcher's Flight - if they clash for prominent spots it could compromise both
The pace early doors between the front runners - if moderate it plays into hold-up hands
Big Bard's consistency issues - his C&D win was at big odds but he's been disappointing since
